# Furniture Finder

> Virtual staging with real furniture you can buy. Straighten a listing photo, set real pieces on the floor at true size, and let your own AI render the room.

Furniture Finder is for landlords, real estate agents, and stagers who want an empty listing photo to show furniture, and for anyone checking whether a piece fits a room before buying it.

- Straighten: wide listing shots make walls lean in. Furniture Finder corrects the camera distortion so verticals stand straight.
- Real pieces: every piece is a real listing with its seller, price, width, height, depth, and photos from more than one side.
- True scale: pieces are set on the floor at their real size, with the window light and floor line kept.
- Your AI renders: the saved room, a mockup, and a mask go to your own model (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Codex, Cursor) through the Furniture Finder MCP server, which does the photoreal render. The site doesn't spend image credits on that step.

## Pricing

Trying a room is free. $12 a month saves rooms, connects your AI over MCP, and adds custom pieces. The render runs on your model. Full page: https://furniturefinder.co/pricing
